name: text-summary
title: Text Summary
description: Count words in a supplied UTF-8 text file. Use for text-summary tasks, not financial analysis or image rendering.
outcome: Return a deterministic word count and the supplied target reference.
source_refs: A new operator-supplied UTF-8 text file
success_criteria: The text 'one two three' produces word_count equal to 3.
An empty text produces word_count equal to 0.
A missing source raises an error without fabricating output.
